data.summary_en: Skill^{infty} makes skill optimization recursive self-improvement: meta agent optimizes task skills via meta-skill and rewrites meta-skill itself by the same process; decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple tasks and cross-domain reused. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, pass rate 60.7% vs human-curated 56.4% and SkillEvolver 54.5%.
